title: Sample Student Support Application — Demo Only

items.text: Sample Student Support Application — Demo Only
Synthetic demonstration document. This is not an official scheme and no institution issues it. It exists only to demonstrate the FormFix AI prototype.
Section A — Applicant details
1. Full name of applicant, exactly as printed on your student record. Required.
2. Date of birth. Write the date in DD/MM/YYYY format. Required.
3. Enrolment number. Nine digits. Copy it exactly, including any leading zeros printed on your record. Required.
Section A — Applicant details (continued)
4. Applicant category. Tick one box only: General, Reserved, or Other. Required.
[  ] General        [  ] Reserved        [  ] Other
5. If you ticked Other in question 4, state the category here. Leave this blank if you did not tick Other.
Office use: verify Section A against the student record before processing.
Section B — Address and contact
6. Postal address for correspondence. Give the house or building, the street, and the locality on separate lines. Required.
7. City or town. Required.
8. PIN code. The PIN code must be six digits. Required.
A PIN code with fewer than six digits cannot be processed and the form is returned to the applicant.
Section B — Address and contact (continued)
9. Contact telephone number. Ten digits, written without a country code. Required.
10. Email address. Optional. Give an address only if you read email regularly.
The office contacts applicants by telephone. Email is used only when a telephone call does not reach the applicant.
Section C — Support request
11. Type of support requested. Choose one: Tuition fee, Hostel fee, Travel, or Equipment. Required.
[  ] Tuition fee    [  ] Hostel fee    [  ] Travel    [  ] Equipment
12. Amount of support requested, in whole rupees.
Round to the nearest rupee. Do not write commas or decimal points.
Section C — Documents and declaration
13. Supporting document reference number. Copy the reference number printed on the identity document you attach at (a). Required.
14. Declaration. Tick this box to confirm that the information given in this form is correct. Required.
[  ] I confirm that the information given above is correct.
Documents to attach
(a) Student identity card. If you do not yet have one, a provisional admission letter is accepted in its place. Required.
(b) Income declaration signed by a parent or guardian. Required. It is used to decide the amount of support.
(c) Bank passbook first page. Required only if you asked for Travel or Equipment support in question 11.
